D4_consequence: exp(-i g V) = cos(g |B|) - i sin(g |B|) V/|B| with |B|^2 = sum_k B_k^dag B_k: the mass angle of every pattern is the operator g |B|; on a Higgs state it is g |beta|

A2_reflection_about_vacuum.coherent_state_symbol: omega (1 - exp(-|alpha|^2)), |alpha|^2 the mean total occupation
A2_reflection_about_vacuum.energy_at_large_occupation: omega for every N >= 1: no cost for a further quantum

A3_central_flux.reading: the cost depends on the occupation parity only: the Z2 bit of HT's C1 (bounded register)

A4_gauss_electric_energy.result: normal-ordered Q^a Q^a vanishes at Pi = 0: no component in V(Phi); the ordering term is linear in the occupation (a mass-type term); the term is the Coulomb part of the gauge exchange

A5_swap_test.normalized: 1 - |Phi_x^dag U Phi_y|^2/(|Phi_x|^2 |Phi_y|^2): homogeneous of degree zero, no modulus term
A5_swap_test.unnormalized: |Phi_x^dag U Phi_y|^2 = |Phi|^4 at Phi_x = Phi_y, U = 1: lambda_0 of order one per link (three links per cell): HT's nonlinear end
